title: Chapter 769
paragraphs: Chapter 769
Episode 189. The Rolling Fortunes (3)
The place Luche and I headed to was the secret construction site of Huangji.
Before entering, we made sure to review Luche's past again and verify it through Yuria.
This was necessary because we couldn't rule out the possibility that Luche might be a spy of Zipfel.
It was a top-secret area that we were taking him to, so the verification was naturally necessary, and Luche accepted it without any resistance.
As a result, it was confirmed that Luche had no relationship with Zipfel and had come to join the alliance with a pure heart.
He couldn't hide his excitement about coming to the top-secret area of the alliance from the start.
"Wow…! As expected of the Vamel Alliance, you guys were hiding something like this!"
Even during all this, when he saw the light left by Ron, Luche calmed his mind and offered his respects for a while.
"What is it, you just left and why did you come back? What did you leave behind? And who is this kid?"
Qwaul, who was in the middle of directing the construction site, approached Jin and spoke.
"I'm not a kid?"
"I think you are."
"My name is Luche Fibrijo, the eldest son of the Fibrijo family, the president of both the official and unofficial fan club of Jin Runcandel…"
"I am the prospective contractee of Barbovo, the God of Architecture, Dr. Qwaul."
When Jin spoke instead, Qwaul's eyes widened.
"What!? Is that true?"
"Your name is Qwaul? Anyway, nice to meet you, I'm also a member of the alliance starting today, let's get along well."
Qwaul skeptically looked Luche up and down.
For a while, Jin explained the trial that Barbovo demanded of Luche to him.

"To become the person in charge of a construction site that even the God of Architecture would be tempted by... Haha, if it's a site designed by me, Qwaul, it can't be helped but to be that way. Hey, kiddo."
Soon Qwaul puffed his chest with confidence.
"It's Luche."
"Right, boy. Go right in and have a good look around for Barbovo. You'll be satisfied for sure."
As we went underground, Luche continued to exclaim in awe.
When you open a door that could barely fit a person, an endless and vast underground space unfolds.
It was much brighter than the ground where the spirit of Gliek still remained.
Magic lamps emitted bright light from ceiling to wall, and members of the alliance were busily moving underneath.
Even to Luche, who still knew nothing about construction, the grandeur of this construction site was clearly felt.
Luche anxiously waited to hear Barbovo's voice.
Jin and Qwaul were also waiting for his voice.
If Barbovo had no reaction even after seeing this place, they would have to reconsider.
[Eh!]
Fortunately, Barbovo immediately spoke up.
Luche, startled, fell on his buttocks, and Jin faced the soul of Barbovo, which had materialized above his head.
"Wow! Mr. Barbovo, let's make a contract now!"
[I don't like it!]
"Ah, what don't you like this time!"

[I, Barbovo, gave you that trial for a reason. I wanted you, who is immature and has no ability, to realize your talent through a preliminary contract with me, and to watch you grow step by step, working tirelessly and making efforts until your blood dries and your bones wear out in order to complete the trial I gave you!]
"Eh? What did you say?"

[I wanted to unleash your talent with my power when you jumped into the construction business and finally became a person in charge of a site that even I, Barbovo, would admire… But you resorted to this trick!?]
"Whether it's a trick or whatever, it's okay if it meets the conditions, right? It seems like you came out because you admired it, Mr. Barbovo."
"I apologize for the late greeting, Mr. Barbovo. I am Jin Runcandel, the owner of the Runcandel brewery."
[Huh… Yes, Jin Runcandel. That's a name I've heard frequently among the gods recently. Did you allow Luche to resort to this trick?]
"Yes, I did. But I didn't think of it as a trick."
[I don't think someone of your caliber wouldn't have known my intentions.]
"Please let go of your anger. Could it be that you don't like this site?"
[That's not it, but it feels like Luche's opportunity to grow as a human has disappeared.]

"The world is very chaotic these days, Mr. Barbovo. If Luche had started working somewhere other than the alliance without meeting me, especially in Zipfel. There would have been a high possibility of using mind manipulation to control him as a slave, or absorbing you, Mr. Barbovo, as a magical stone."
Barbovo surprisingly seemed to agree with Jin's words.
[You're not wrong. If it were this idiot, he might have been caught by Zipfel by boasting about my abilities. Then I would have been trapped in a magical stone.]

"So, even if it's a little disappointing, please join us. Even though Luche hasn't gone through the trials entirely alone, as a member of the alliance and the key manager of this site, he will realize a lot."
Jin continued to speak in a very friendly atmosphere, but in fact, Barbovo was overwhelmed by the strange majesty radiating from him.
It was also because of the stories circulating among the middle and lower tier gods.
Jin realized that Barbovo had been taken aback.
"If there's any rudeness in my story, please let me know."
[It's not that. I was just thinking about whether you really are that significant.]
"What does that mean?"
"I am referring to whether you are someone who can protect the gods who are afraid of being absorbed into the Demon Stone."
That was the content mentioned frequently among the middle and lower gods in recent times.
Among the gods, there were many who feared being absorbed into the Demon Stone.
At present, the Demon Stone had become more powerful, and the middle and lower gods were at a level where they could be absorbed the moment they were caught by Zipfel.
When Barbovo explained this to Jin, he nodded seriously.

"Defeating Zipfel is naturally a mission I must fulfill, so naturally I have no choice but to help the gods in the process. But even now we have quite a few gods in our alliance, and I've never heard this kind of story."
"There are areas that newcomers like Picon Minte can't participate in. On the other hand, higher gods like Olta have little to do with us."
"Either way, I am certainly willing to help. I don't see any reason to ask for a reward, as preventing gods from being absorbed into the Demon Stone will prevent Zipfel's power from growing."
"It seems like you want something in return from me?"
"I would certainly be disappointed if you choose not to help us in this situation, but I wouldn't hold any grudges against you, Lord Barbovo."
"Lord Barbovo, can't you just help us? Please make a contract with me."
After hearing Jin and Luche's words, Barbovo seemed to be immersed in thought for a moment.
Eventually, he seemed to make a decision and nodded.

"Fine, I'll help. But you must also protect the gods close to me. They are particularly at risk because their location is almost exposed to Zipfel. There are three. Keitam, the god of painting, Ox, the god of frames, and Telpen, the god of pencils. Especially the god of painting, you and... "
Barbovo seemed about to say something more but shook his head instead.

"...It's probably best for you to hear it directly from Keitam. Anyway, find them and protect them. I won't tell the other gods about this. It might unnecessarily speed up Zipfel's search for the gods."
Jin was curious about Keitam, but decided not to ask more and meet him directly.
"If you let me know their locations, I will bring them immediately."
"I'll write it down later. I'm counting on you from now on. Luche, you naively bright guy. Kneel devoutly. I'm going to proceed with the contract."
"Ooh!"
As Luche sat down, a round circle was drawn on the floor, and the light shone.
"I, Barbovo, the god of architecture, make a contract with Luche Fibrijo and bless him. Luche Fibrijo will now be able to borrow my power not as a preliminary but as a formal contractor..."
The light seeped into Luche's body. Luche trembled for a moment, then suddenly opened his eyes, and now the construction site appeared completely different.
Like a fog lifting to reveal something hidden, he began to understand the problems scattered throughout the site at a glance.
"This is crazy, so this is the power of a god."
"Ugh, I'm tired after finishing the contract. I'll rest for a while. Have Luche do some work. There will be more than one or two things to fix."
"Sir Jin! No, Lord? Your Highness? Union Chief? I want to call you something different."
"Usually, this guy is referred to as the Lord."

"Then I'll call you Brother Jin, Brother! It seems there are many parts of the construction site that I can work on. For starters, that pillar joint will crack in about two months, and that ground over there can be dug deeper."
"What? You can tell all that just by looking?"
"The location for the materials is not suitable either, that side is weak, so it will sink if it gets heavier."
These were all areas that Qwaul had been vaguely aware of.
Therefore, Qwaul was even more shocked.
"The gate? Do you see it over there? They are working to create a gate for the ship to leave, does it seem okay?"
"Hmm, I think I need to watch that a bit more. What kind of structure is the gate?"
"Take a look at this blueprint......"
For a while, Luche and Qwaul talked while looking at the blueprint.
Every time Qwaul nodded as if admiring, Luche spoke with an excited voice due to his newfound sensation.
What's more surprising is that Luche's power is still at a novice level.
Just as Jin has been refining his skills, Luche can also enhance his ability by studying architecture.
"Hey, Jin. It seems like the construction will speed up considerably. We need to increase our manpower and supply of materials."

"I'll start staying here from today, Brother Jin! I'll write down my address, so please take care of my family. Don't send them here as it will be hectic, just get a house in a relatively safe area. I'm busy so I'll introduce my family later!"
Jin nodded his head in surprise.
Luche was already rolling up his sleeves, ready to start working.
"Got it. If you need anything, ask Qwaul to request it from Tikan."
"Yes, Brother, please take a look!"
"Doctor, work with Luche and give me a rough estimate of the completion date."
"Got it, I'll be waiting in anticipation."
When they left Gwamhwangi and returned to Tikan, another piece of good news was waiting for Jin.
"Jin."
As if she had been waiting, Valeria came straight to Jin.
"You look happy. Did something good happen? Valeria."
Valeria took out a piece of paper from her pocket.
On that paper were dozens of names that Jin saw for the first time.
"What are these names?"
With a grin, Valeria replied.

"These are the names of the magic engineers who requested to transfer after seeing my name. I told you, didn't I? As soon as my existence became known, people obsessed with Hister's magic like Keydart Hole would come."
The luck kept rolling in.
